what_works: Bright primary green accent paired with light background creates high contrast and visual hierarchy.
Large headline with generous white space emphasizes the main message and improves readability.
Smartphone illustration with floating money graphics adds dynamic motion and reinforces the financial theme.
Rounded button with consistent 8px radius and clear call-to-action improves clickability and visual cohesion.
Statistic cards use bold numbers and green accents to draw attention while maintaining a clean layout.
